ogd-settings-interface.title: Interface
ogd-settings-interface.description: Choose the language used throughout Owen Graphite.

ogd-style-settings-language.title: Language
ogd-style-settings-language.description: Follow Obsidian's language or override it for Owen Graphite Style Settings.

ogd-body-size.title: Body font size
ogd-body-size.description: Base font size for body text such as paragraphs and list items.

ogd-max-width.title: Maximum content width
ogd-max-width.description: Choose a reading width for long prose or a wider width for tables and reports.

ogd-modern-tables.title: Enhanced modern table style
ogd-modern-tables.description: Strengthens table headers, first columns, hover states, and PDF borders with a report-oriented treatment.

ogd-print-avoid-breaks.title: Prevent PDF block splitting
ogd-print-avoid-breaks.description: Reduces page breaks inside callouts, tables, Mermaid diagrams, code blocks, and images.

ogd-report-mode.title: Report mode (numbered headings + indentation + serif)
ogd-report-mode.description: Applies cover, numbering, indentation, and serif body settings together.

ogd-pdf-compact.title: PDF compact report
ogd-pdf-compact.description: Reduces spacing between headings, body text, callouts, tables, and references for denser PDF output.

ogd-pdf-visibility.title: Enhanced PDF report visibility
ogd-pdf-visibility.description: Increases contrast for document status labels, callouts, and end markers without changing heading hierarchy or table design.

ogd-pdf-screen-delivery.title: PDF screen-delivery visibility
ogd-pdf-screen-delivery.description: Adjusts heading hierarchy, body and table sizes, callout separation, and label tone for email, Teams, and browser previews.

ogd-pdf-client-delivery.title: Recommended client PDF preset
ogd-pdf-client-delivery.description: Tunes body text, tables, callouts, code, and links together for client-facing PDFs.

ogd-pdf-font-size.title: PDF font size
ogd-pdf-font-size.description: Adjusts body, list, callout, code, and header/footer label sizes without changing heading hierarchy or table design.

ogd-pdf-link-mode.title: PDF link output mode
ogd-pdf-link-mode.description: Choose whether external URLs appear inline, stay hidden, or are organized around references in PDF exports.

ogd-serif-body.title: Serif body font
ogd-serif-body.description: Switches body text to Noto Serif KR for long-report readability.

ogd-indent-paragraph.title: First-line indentation
ogd-indent-paragraph.description: Applies a 1em first-line indent for Korean report styling.

ogd-heading-template.title: Heading design template
ogd-heading-template.description: Applies the H1-H4 design to Live Preview and PDF output.

ogd-auto-dark.title: Follow OS dark mode automatically
ogd-auto-dark.description: Applies dark theme variables when the operating system uses dark mode.

ogd-glass-intensity.title: Desktop glass intensity
ogd-glass-intensity.description: Adjusts transparency and shadow intensity for desktop UI chrome. Reduced lowers blur for battery life and lower-performance devices.

ogd-motion-intensity.title: Desktop hover motion
ogd-motion-intensity.description: Adjusts hover and press lift for buttons, menu items, and setting rows. Off preserves color and shadow feedback without movement.

ogd-interface-font-stack.title: Custom interface font
ogd-interface-font-stack.description: Leave empty to follow Obsidian's interface font. Example: "Malgun Gothic", Pretendard, sans-serif.

ogd-reading-font-stack.title: Custom reading font
ogd-reading-font-stack.description: Leave empty to follow Obsidian's text font. Example: "Noto Serif KR", serif.

ogd-code-font-stack.title: Custom code font
ogd-code-font-stack.description: Leave empty to follow Obsidian's monospace font. Example: "D2Coding", "JetBrains Mono", monospace.

ogd-status-font-stack.title: Custom status bar font
ogd-status-font-stack.description: Leave empty to follow the interface font. Example: "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif.

ogd-settings-pdf-marginalia.title: Small PDF header/footer labels
ogd-settings-pdf-marginalia.description: Shows header and footer labels only in PDF output, not in on-screen Reading View.

ogd-pdf-header-enabled.title: Show first-page header label
ogd-pdf-header-enabled.description: Shows one label at the top of the first PDF page. Turning this off hides it even when text or a preset is configured.

ogd-pdf-footer-enabled.title: Show last-page footer label
ogd-pdf-footer-enabled.description: Shows one centered label below the final PDF content. Turning this off hides it even when text or a preset is configured.

ogd-pdf-label-layout.title: PDF label layout
ogd-pdf-label-layout.description: Single label shows one phrase. Key/Value joins a pair such as `Prepared by` + `Owen Lee`.

ogd-pdf-marginalia-preset.title: Header/footer quick text
ogd-pdf-marginalia-preset.description: Output combinations used when custom text is empty. Custom header or footer text takes precedence.

ogd-pdf-marginalia-accent.title: Header/footer text color
ogd-pdf-marginalia-accent.description: Shared text color for both labels. The default is a graphite tone suited to printed output.

ogd-pdf-marginalia-style.title: Header/footer label style
ogd-pdf-marginalia-style.description: Provides surfaces that remain stable in PDF engines without changing position or page flow.

ogd-pdf-marginalia-size.title: Header/footer label size
ogd-pdf-marginalia-size.description: Adjusts text and internal padding with two print-stable sizes.

ogd-pdf-header-key-palette.title: Header key color
ogd-pdf-header-key-palette.description: Color of the left key area in the first-page header, such as `Prepared by`.

ogd-pdf-header-value-palette.title: Header value color
ogd-pdf-header-value-palette.description: Color of the right value area in the first-page header, such as `Owen Lee - Sr. CSA`.

ogd-pdf-header-text.title: First-page header pair 1 key text
ogd-pdf-header-text.description: The full phrase in single-label layout or the left key in pair 1. Example: `Prepared by`.

ogd-pdf-header-value.title: First-page header pair 1 value text
ogd-pdf-header-value.description: The right value in pair 1, such as `Owen Lee` or `Sr. CSA`. Not used by single-label layout.

ogd-pdf-header-dual-pair.title: Show first-page header pair 2
ogd-pdf-header-dual-pair.description: Adds only the second key/value pair to the existing one-pair layout. Selecting `Two Key/Value pairs` in PDF label layout has the same effect.

ogd-pdf-header2-key-palette.title: Header pair 2 key color
ogd-pdf-header2-key-palette.description: Color of the second header key segment, such as `Reviewed by`.

ogd-pdf-header2-value-palette.title: Header pair 2 value color
ogd-pdf-header2-value-palette.description: Color of the second header value segment, such as `Graphite QA`.

ogd-pdf-header-text-2.title: First-page header pair 2 key text
ogd-pdf-header-text-2.description: The second key segment. Example: `Reviewed by`.

ogd-pdf-header-value-2.title: First-page header pair 2 value text
ogd-pdf-header-value-2.description: The second value segment. Example: `Design QA` or `2026-05-17`.

ogd-pdf-header-position.title: First-page header position
ogd-pdf-header-position.description: Choose the first-page header position. Key/value segments stay joined at the same anchor. The last-page footer remains fixed at bottom center for stability.

ogd-pdf-footer-key-palette.title: Footer key color
ogd-pdf-footer-key-palette.description: Color of the left key segment in the last-page footer, such as `Confidential`.

ogd-pdf-footer-value-palette.title: Footer value color
ogd-pdf-footer-value-palette.description: Color of the right value segment in the last-page footer, such as `End of Document`.

ogd-pdf-footer-text.title: Last-page footer key text
ogd-pdf-footer-text.description: The full phrase in single-label layout or the left key in key/value layout. Example: `Confidential`.

ogd-pdf-footer-value.title: Last-page footer value text
ogd-pdf-footer-value.description: The right value in key/value layout, such as `Internal Use Only` or `End of Document`. Not used by single-label layout.
